inlines.v: PRODUC'TION, noun [Latin productio.] 1. The act or process of producing, bringing forth or exhibiting to view. 2. That which is produced or made; as the productions of the earth, comprehending all vegetables and fruits; the productions of art, as manufactures of every kind, paintings, sculpture, etc.; the productions of intellect or genius, as poems and prose compositions.
